newsitem.title: USA: Hightec acquires majority of Sinclare.
newsitem.headline: Hightec acquires majority of Sinclare.

text.p: Hightec Inc said Wednesday it had reached agreement with the controlling shareholders of Sinclare Group Inc to exchange 1 million shares of Hightec stock for eight million shares of Sinclare.
Sinclare has about 15.8 million shares outstanding.
Larry Stockett, president of Hightec, will become president of Sinclare. Hightec said new capital will be invested in Sinclare to settle past debt and launch a new software product called Flexquote.
Montreal-based Sinclare publishes the New Industrialist stock market magazine in Canada, and developed FlexQuote, a stock market quotation and research service available over the Internet.
